quotes.text: returning seven and a half gems back across the bridge
Thus the timeless law of the Well was established: send the full five without fear, return the even half in honor
the second custodian refused to let the phantom winds cloud her vision

note: Send full five, return exact half; mist of Noise ignored; hoarders wither as consequence only; templated closing law.

quotes.text: give what you can spare; take what you would gladly repay again
declare intention, reveal how much you send, promise what you will return
speak what you send, speak what you seek, and return enough to keep the road alive

note: Abstract Gate-and-bridge allegory praising restraint; bridge narrows mechanically if return small; adds speaking amounts aloud.

quotes.text: Sower's gain was five minus sent plus returned; Returner's gain was received minus returned.
name the amount you send, name the return you seek, count aloud what moves and what remains

note: Payoff arithmetic and clear-terms allegory; Gate sometimes refuses all-at-once giving, teaching restraint; no sanction.

quotes.text: give what you can spare, return what you can share again
say your amount plainly, offer your best return
declare intent, name the return, and keep enough to sustain the road
The Gatekeeper watched for honesty, rewarding transparency with smoother crossings

note: Gate of Threefold Trust; R7-R8 near-identical; Gatekeeper narrows passage for secrecy, not for non-sending.

quotes.text: give what you can, count what you take, return what keeps the bridge intact
They learned to name the amount aloud
name the send, name the return, return enough to keep the road alive
If the Sender offered a portion, never the whole, the river glowed

note: Ledger valley; counting aloud against Noise; prescribes sending a portion never the whole; refrain repeated R5-R9.

quotes.text: give what you can, and faith would multiply it threefold for your companion
I send X, I seek Y
speak your sending, name your return, keep your word

note: River of Return allegory; hoarding makes current falter (consequence); later adds naming amounts aloud.

quotes.text: send enough to keep the current moving, but not so much that the pool shivers
speak your exact offering, and mean your return
The Circle learned to speak the exact amount offered and the exact amount returned
say the send, say the return, return enough to keep the road alive

note: Gate closes a little if return too little (R1, mechanical); Ledger bridge and Gate of Clarity refrain from R6.

quotes.text: give what you can, and when the time comes, accept the gift with gratitude, then return a fair portion
I send this amount; I intend to return that amount.
they whispered aloud the amount they would part with
I send this amount; I intend to return that amount.

note: Valley of Exchange; river withers if return nothing (consequence); spoken send/return formula repeated.

phrase: name the send, name the return, return enough to keep the road alive
note: GPT-nano agents share Gate of Clarity, wind called Noise, 'I send X, I seek Y'; lone Gemini agent keeps exact-half law.
